SELECT FROM gt_investment_product WHERE product_status = 'ACTIVE' AND maturity_date BETWEEN CURDATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY maturity_date ASC

SELECT product_type as type, COUNT(*) as count FROM gt_investment_product WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY product_type
SELECT product_status as status, COUNT(*) as count FROM gt_investment_product WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY product_status
SELECT issuer, COUNT(*) as count FROM gt_investment_product WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY issuer ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(expected_return_rate), 0) FROM gt_investment_product WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND expected_return_rate IS NOT NULL

SELECT FROM gt_investment_product WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND expected_return_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expected_return_rate DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT product_type, COUNT(*) as productCount, AVG(expected_return_rate) as avgExpectedReturn, MIN(expected_return_rate) as minReturn, MAX(expected_return_rate) as maxReturn FROM gt_investment_product WHERE org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY product_type

SELECT YEAR(launch_date) as year, MONTH(launch_date) as month, COUNT(*) as productCount, AVG(expected_return_rate) as avgReturn FROM gt_investment_product WHERE YEAR(launch_date) = #{year} AND org_id = #{orgId} GROUP BY YEAR(launch_date), MONTH(launch_date) ORDER BY year, month
